description.content: Returns active protected groups. Supplying group_id performs a scoped single-group lookup for any authorized UI user. Omitting group_id lists all active protected groups and is only available to internal Noyo users.

query.description: Group ID to look up protected state for
Search term for filtering protected groups by group name, DBA name, or group ID
Organization ID to filter protected groups by
The max size of each page of results
The integer offset at which to start the page

response.name: Successful Response - Returns active protected groups
